title: CAS-06988 — The Brendan O'Connor Show — RTÉ Radio 1
text:
Programme: The Brendan O'Connor Show
Broadcast / VOD service: RTÉ Radio 1
Date broadcast or accessed: 01.03.2026
Statute and/or regulatory code: Section 46J(1)(a) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended. Code of Fairness, Objectivity & Impartiality in News and Current Affairs: Obligation 14.6
Short description: The complaint is about a panel discussion regarding an award show incident in which a racial slur shouted by a man with Tourette syndrome was included in the broadcast. The complaint alleges the discussion offered no alternative perspectives and caused undue offence.
Outcome: Referred
Commission Decision: Refer the complaint to an authorised person to be considered for investigation, pursuant to s48(5) of the Broadcasting Act 2009, as amended.
Commission Decision Date: 23.04.2026
